commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin || exit 41
echo "ARCHIVE_TOOLS_BEGIN"
for tool in 7zz 7z bsdtar tar unar python3; do command -v "$tool" || true; done
echo "ARCHIVE_TOOLS_END"
python3 - <<'PY'
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError,URLError
import json
base='https://data.4tu.nl/v2/articles/88d22c60-21b3-4ea8-90db-20249a5be2a7'
for endpoint in ('','/files'):
 try:
  with urlopen(Request(base+endpoint,headers={'User-Agent':'BloomML-research-metadata/1.0','Accept':'application/json'}),timeout=35) as resp:
   data=json.loads(resp.read(2000000).decode('utf-8'))
  print('WUR_ENDPOINT|',endpoint or 'dataset','|OK',sep='')
  files=data if isinstance(data,list) else data.get('files',[])
  if not isinstance(files,list):files=[]
  for f in files[:12]:
   print('WUR_FILE|'+json.dumps({k:f.get(k) for k in ('name','id','uuid','size','download_url','supplied_md5','is_link_only','computed_md5')},ensure_ascii=False))
  if isinstance(data,dict):
   print('WUR_DATASET|'+json.dumps({k:data.get(k) for k in ('uuid','doi','title','published_date','license')},default=str,ensure_ascii=False)[:2000])
 except Exception as exc:
  print('WUR_ENDPOINT|',endpoint or 'dataset','|FAIL|',type(exc).__name__,'|',str(exc)[:220],sep='')
print('WUR_PREFLIGHT_FINISHED')
PY
